title: Gaussian invariance under scalar reflection
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. The map $(x,y)\mapsto(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y,\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,x-\rho y)$ preserves the product of two standard Gaussian measures on $\mathbb R$.
